title: Setting Aside an Ex Parte Order under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019

content.scenario: The National Commission passes an ex parte order against a company for non-compliance with a consumer protection regulation. The company, which was not given an opportunity to be heard, applies to the National Commission to set aside the order.
content.outcome: The National Commission considers the company's application and may set aside the ex parte order if it is satisfied that the company was not given a fair opportunity to be heard or that there are other sufficient grounds for setting aside the order.
